structuredContent.body:
SDK multi-RID container publishing truncates colon-bearing label values before each child publish. The shared target rebinds the publisher-owned source, revision, version, and created labels for consumers that provide all three provenance inputs.

The overrides and rebinding require complete publisher metadata, preserving ordinary local SDK generation and partial-metadata behavior. Seven real MSBuild tests cover complete, partial, absent, disabled, single-RID, multi-RID, and removed-target behavior. The test generates escaped fixture XML without parsing XML, and uses scoped fixed-fixture subprocess justifications consistent with sibling tests. The full publisher suite passes 142 tests.

The production target remains byte-identical to reviewed aea707d after PR #127 restored the preincident tree; only the fixture test was hardened in response to Codacy. Both historical identical-tree proofs are retained. Merge remains subject to every effective required context and ordinary CI for the final head. No release is authorized by this PR alone.
structuredContent.title: fix(container): preserve publisher provenance across RIDs
